description: Use this when the buyer wants flowers delivered in Prague (or picked up there) and you need concrete bouquets: it returns only bouquets that can really arrive at the given place and time, with price, delivery fee, total and the earliest delivery time, in the storefront's recommended order. Pass what the buyer said: free text, occasion, budget, where, date and a deliver-by time. Do not use it for general flower advice or for orders outside Prague. Each call shows the buyer a carousel, so call it once per request and search again only when the buyer asks for something different; for 'as soon as possible' leave date and deliver_by out (every result carries its earliest time). Show 3–6 results; then use pinflower_get_bouquet for details or pinflower_create_order to order.

budget_max_czk.description: Bouquet price limit in CZK (delivery not included).

category.description: A category slug as results show it (e.g. roses, tulips).

currency.description: Add an approximate EUR/USD preview for a buyer abroad (default czk). The charge is always in CZK.

date.description: Delivery/pickup day: 'today', 'tomorrow' or YYYY-MM-DD (Prague). Omit for as soon as possible.

deliver_by.description: HH:MM (24 h): must arrive by then. Without date it means today.

detail.description: full adds composition and a short description (default short).

fulfilment.description: delivery (default) or pickup at the florist's shop.

locale.description: The buyer's language for names, texts and links: cs, en, ru or uk (default cs).

occasion.description: Only when the buyer named the occasion. Never assume 'sympathy'.

query.description: Free text in any language: flower, colour or bouquet name, e.g. 'red roses', 'tulipány', 'пионы'.

ready_now.description: Only bouquets already made and waiting (fastest).

sort.description: recommended (default, the storefront's order), cheapest, most expensive, or soonest arrival.

style.description: as_pictured = looks like the photo; florists_style = composed fresh by the florist in that spirit.

where.description: Where the flowers go, as the buyer said it: a Prague district ('Praha 5'), a quarter ('Vinohrady', 'Smíchov') or a street address. Omit when unknown.

name: pinflower_search_bouquets
title: Find bouquets
